title: Ginsenoside Rg2 ameliorates metabolic dysfunction-related steatohepatitis via the Nrf2 pathway by suppressing inflammation, apoptosis, oxidative stress and fibrosis.
authors: Chen, Jiabing; Wu, Xiaoqin; Chen, Tingting; Cui, Tianqi; Wu, Dailin; Qiu, Min; Yi, Qincheng; Zhang, Ziyi; Ma, Chenlu; Gao, Yong; Zhang, Yinliang; Luo, Zhuohui; Huang, Jiawen
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参皂苷Rg2通过Nrf2通路改善代谢相关脂肪性肝炎，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ginsenoside Rg2 (G-Rg2) is a bioactive saponin derived from Panax ginseng, recognized for its diverse pharmacological activities, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective effects. Nevertheless, the therapeutic mechanisms underlying its effects in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) are still not well understood. PURPOSE: The current work examined the protective role of G-Rg2 on MASH and elucidate the molecular mechanisms. METHODS: Eight-week-old male C57BL/6 J mice received a standard diet containing Methionine- and choline-deficient diet (MCD), while LX2 cells were induced by TGFbeta, serving as in vivo and in vitro models, respectively. To assess the protective effect of G-Rg2 in alleviating MASH, we conducted histopathological staining, utilized commercial kits, performed qPCR, immunoblotting, and immunofluorescence, as well as executed a cellular thermal shift assay. Additionally, network pharmacology prediction, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation analyses were employed. RESULTS: G-Rg2 reduced body weight loss (p < 0.001), AST/ALT (p < 0.001), hepatic inflammation (CD68, NFkappaB, IL1beta downregulated, CD206 upregulated; p < 0.05), apoptosis (Bcl-2 up, Bax down), oxidative stress (SOD, GSH increased, MDA reduced; p < 0.05), and fibrosis (alpha-SMA decreased). In TGFbeta-induced LX2 cells, it suppressed inflammation (IL6, TNFalpha down; p < 0.05), ROS, and fibrosis (COL1A1, alpha-SMA down; p < 0.001) via stabilizing NRF2 binding. In NRF2((-)/(-)) mice or with ML385 (Nrf2 inhibitor), G-Rg2's effects were abrogated (p > 0.05), confirming NRF2 dependency. CONCLUSION: This study is the first to confirm that G-Rg2 binds to and regulates Nrf2, and further illustrates that it alleviates MASH by activating the NRF2 signaling pathway to inhibit inflammation, cell apoptosis, oxidative stress, and fibrosis. This establishes a conceptual foundation for the future use of G-Rg2 in MASH treatment and supports the development of natural product-based therapeutic strategies derived from dietary sources.
abstract_zh: 背景：人参皂苷Rg2（G-Rg2）是从人参（Panax ginseng）中提取的一种生物活性皂苷，因其具有抗炎、抗氧化和保肝等多种药理活性而受到认可。然而，其在代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）中发挥治疗作用的机制仍未被充分理解。目的：本研究探讨了G-Rg2对MASH的保护作用，并阐明其分子机制。方法：八周龄雄性C57BL/6 J小鼠接受含蛋氨酸和胆碱缺乏饮食（MCD）的标准饮食，同时LX2细胞经TGFbeta诱导，分别作为体内和体外模型。为评估G-Rg2缓解MASH的保护作用，我们进行了组织病理学染色、使用商业试剂盒、进行qPCR、免疫印迹和免疫荧光检测，以及执行细胞热位移分析。此外，还采用了网络药理学预测、分子对接和分子动力学模拟分析。结果：G-Rg2减轻了体重下降（p < 0.001）、AST/ALT水平（p < 0.001）、肝脏炎症（CD68、NFkappaB、IL1beta下调，CD206上调；p < 0.05）、细胞凋亡（Bcl-2上调，Bax下调）、氧化应激（SOD、GSH增加，MDA减少；p < 0.05）和纤维化（alpha-SMA减少）。在TGFbeta诱导的LX2细胞中，它通过稳定NRF2结合抑制了炎症（IL6、TNFalpha下调；p < 0.05）、ROS和纤维化（COL1A1、alpha-SMA下调；p < 0.001）。在NRF2((-)/(-))小鼠或使用ML385（Nrf2抑制剂）时，G-Rg2的作用被消除（p > 0.05），证实了其对NRF2的依赖性。结论：本研究首次确认G-Rg2与Nrf2结合并调控Nrf2，进一步阐明其通过激活NRF2信号通路抑制炎症、细胞凋亡、氧化应激和纤维化来缓解MASH。这为未来G-Rg2在MASH治疗中的应用奠定了概念基础，并支持开发源自膳食来源的天然产物治疗策略。
